description:
Outcome: Run and meaningfully test both existing components, from frontend/package.json and backend/pyproject.toml.
Scope: Document clean-environment install/test/start commands, establish missing test/runtime dependencies, a real frontend smoke test, backend runner and local frontend/API integration. Excludes: product features and new frameworks/providers.
Acceptance: Both components start using documented commands; meaningful frontend and backend smoke tests run; combined startup/readiness commands are established before enabling VERIFY. Investigate TestClient dependency requirements such as httpx.
Behaviour: Startup failures give actionable errors.
Verification: Execute documented smoke checks during implementation, not setup. Prerequisites: none. Assumptions: backend runner, ports and combined verification command remain TBD.
title: Establish development and verification commands
